author: J626480
quote: The music, the characters, the many different places you can visit, the open world setting riding epona, this game was PERFECTION. After 20 years i couldnt get the music out of my head and occasionally would look it up to listen to it all day and get reminded of it. None of the zelda’s that get released now have the charm of this game. I’ve tried playing them and they dont live up to it. This is, by far, the best game of all time.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: J626480
quote:
After 13 long years of waiting, Grand Theft Auto 6 wasn’t supposed to be perfect, BUT it should’ve included the very basics of what makes GTA, GTA. 
**** stealing cars. I feel this one is pretty self explanatory. The game is named Grand Theft Auto, yet, you cannot steal a car. 
**** cannot shoot certain NPCs. Now, im not in the business of going around shooting NPCs constantly , as I am more of a story-loving player. But not being able to shoot “protected people” NPCs? In GTA?! Comeon. Leave politics out ****.
3.Other various elements, for example, not being able to pick up hookers. This is GTA, for gods sake. There are THOUSANDS of videos where you are picking up, riding around with , exploding, etc hookers and this was left out. 

This game is a CRIME SIMULATOR. I cannot commit “crimes” in a game because people get offended? After 13 years of waitint this is what you deliver to the people? This game is definitely not what we waited for.
